items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Or maybe just like you said Kidron Day or this day there, or Martin Bergman, or Harry James, some folks they patented completely behind them.

ctx.x: But if something they make you would like. And you were quite nice, you pick up on what somebody else makes. But I mean they said a copy like some of the other ones, copy completely behind Louis Armstrong. Or maybe just like you said Kidron Day or this day there, or Martin Bergman, or Harry James, some folks they patented completely behind them.

But I never did try to imitate really. But it's a dude that something, make something, I mean that's a certain part of playing a number, a little thing he'd make. And I like that. And I get that in my head, I get on my arm, I play that number, I put that in there, and that's what you mean, kind of like, something. I might hear myself, I hear me make it, and it's too easy to hear why I hear me playing it. And you like that? Well that's it easy, you know, I'm only playing seven numbers that's made. Can you play…
